reply_text:
I replied in #coastal-team, in Bettina's thread, saying I haven't set up the Monday 08:00 digest.

I did not create the recurring job. My reply said a scheduled job might not reliably read those channels or post on its own, but I didn't test that. The real constraint is that scheduled jobs here can't post back into a channel from this session. Someone with scheduler access will need to set it up, or Bettina can ask me for a one-off digest of #coastal-team and #coastal-random at any time.
